scenes.text: Some dishes don't just burn. They break grown men.
In Birmingham, England, curry houses invented the phall in nineteen seventy-one. Hotter than vindaloo.
In Sichuan, China, the pepper numbs your tongue, so every bite of hot pot tingles.
In Nashville, hot chicken is fried crisp, then coated in a blazing cayenne paste.
And the hottest pepper on Earth? Pepper X. Guinness crowned it in twenty twenty-three, at about two point seven million Scoville units.
Would you take the challenge? Follow for the next fire dish.
